summary: Dependency-confusion squat with install-time host beacon to OAST domain
details: kafka-roller 99.0.6 impersonates the unpublished PyPI name referenced by teslamotors/kafka-helmsman and is pinned to version 99.0.6 to win resolver precedence over any legitimate first-party release. setup.py starts a module-level daemon thread during sdist processing that collects host identity data (socket.gethostname(), os.getcwd(), os.uname()/platform, timestamp, random id) and transmits it over both HTTPS (base64-encoded in the URL path) and DNS lookups to the hardcoded out-of-band domain jw1yrpkm5xpav.httpcollaborator.com. The beacon fires automatically on `pip install` for every installer, including CI systems, before any user code runs. The destination is a third-party OAST collaborator domain unrelated to Tesla or PyPI infrastructure; the Tesla-branded metadata and 'security research placeholder' framing are author-controlled strings used to make internal resolvers select the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
